name: Generic or root word titles
description: Titles consisting of only a single generic or root word that cannot be broken down further are not permitted.
source_clause: The proposed titles should preferably contain more than one word formed by combining distinct and meaningful terms. Generic, or root word titles shall not be registered.
retrieval_chunk: The proposed titles should preferably contain more than one word formed by combining distinct and meaningful terms. Generic, or root word titles shall not be registered. Generic or Root words are those words which cannot be broken down further. Here are some example: Manthan, Darpan, Inspire, Success, Khulasa, Rahasya, Katha, Herald, Malar, Mukhi, Nukkad, etc.

name: Phonetic and visual similarity
description: Proposed titles must be unique and not phonetically or visually similar to an existing registered title.
source_clause: The proposed titles must be unique and shall not be phonetically or visually similar to any existing registered title whether in the same language across India or any other language within the same State.
detection_hint: similarity threshold > 80 on phonetic or visual comparison
retrieval_chunk: The proposed titles must be unique and shall not be phonetically or visually similar to any existing registered title whether in the same language across India or any other language within the same State.

name: Re-arranging existing titles
description: Titles that combine existing registered titles whether in full, in part or by rearranging words or inserting non-distinctive terms that do not create a significantly different title will not be registered.
source_clause: Titles that combine existing registered titles whether in full, in part or by rearranging words or inserting non-distinctive terms that do not create a significantly different title will not be registered.
detection_hint: permutation/combination of core words of an existing title
retrieval_chunk: Titles that combine existing registered titles whether in full, in part or by rearranging words or inserting non-distinctive terms that do not create a significantly different title will not be registered.

name: Individual names as titles
description: Titles denoting the name of an individual should not be the names of the owner or publisher of the proposed periodical.
source_clause: Titles denoting the name of an individual should not be the names of the owner or publisher of the proposed periodical.
detection_hint: NER matching owner/publisher name against title
retrieval_chunk: Titles denoting the name of an individual should not be the names of the owner or publisher of the proposed periodical. (Example: "Rajan Times", "Deepak Samachar", "Jitendra News", etc.).

name: Insignificantly prefixing or suffixing
description: Titles formed by insignificantly prefixing or suffixing generic or repetitive terms to an existing title will not be approved.
source_clause: Titles formed by insignificantly prefixing or suffixing generic or repetitive terms to an existing title- such as addition names of cities or states, periodicity or language, or addition of articles (A, An, The) prepositions or adjectives to an already existing title will not be approved.
retrieval_chunk: Titles formed by insignificantly prefixing or suffixing generic or repetitive terms to an existing title- such as addition names of cities or states, periodicity or language, or addition of articles (A, An, The) prepositions or adjectives to an already existing title will not be approved. (Examples: The Times, Daily, Dainik, Weekly, V/Wartha, Aaj, Today, Express, News, Khabar, Samachar, Bulletin, Diary, India, National, Rashtriya, "Saptahik Weekly", "Sandhya Evening", or "Daily Dainik News" etc.).

name: Judicial and copyright infringement
description: Titles must not violate judicial pronouncements, copyrights, or trademarks, or involve contempt of court or defamation.
source_clause: The proposed title shall not be registered if it is found to be in violation of any judicial pronouncement including matters involving copyright, trademark infringement, contempt of court and defamation.
detection_hint: trademark search and defamatory keyword checks
retrieval_chunk: The proposed title shall not be registered if it is found to be in violation of any judicial pronouncement including matters involving copyright, trademark infringement, contempt of court and defamation.

name: Government emblems and names
description: Titles cannot use names or emblems associated with the government, national bodies, or official institutions.
source_clause: Titles similar to any national symbol, national motto, or suggesting misleading association with Central Government/State Governments/Local bodies/Constitutional bodies/Statutory bodies or are violative of "The Emblems and Names (Prevention of Improper Use) Act, 1950” or any other law in force will not be registered.
retrieval_chunk: Titles similar to any national symbol, national motto, or suggesting misleading association with Central Government/State Governments/Local bodies/Constitutional bodies/Statutory bodies or are violative of "The Emblems and Names (Prevention of Improper Use) Act, 1950” or any other law in force will not be registered.

name: Foreign location association
description: Titles suggesting association with a foreign country or city that does not correspond to the place of publication are not allowed.
source_clause: Titles suggesting any association with a foreign country, city, or place which does not correspond to the State or place of publication of the periodical shall not be registered
detection_hint: foreign location names in title without domestic publishing basis
retrieval_chunk: Titles suggesting any association with a foreign country, city, or place which does not correspond to the State or place of publication of the periodical shall not be registered (Example: “South Africa Times", "Canada Times", or "New York Mirror").

name: Broadcasting title restrictions
description: Titles registered as a TV or Radio Channel with the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting can only be registered by their owner.
source_clause: Title registered as a Satellite TV Channel/FM Radio/Community Radio Station with the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting shall not be registered unless the application is made by their owner or by their representative on his behalf
retrieval_chunk: Title registered as a Satellite TV Channel/FM Radio/Community Radio Station with the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting shall not be registered unless the application is made by their owner or by their representative on his behalf (Example: Titles such as "News Nation", "News Time", "Aajtak News", "Akaashvani Times", "Dabang News", etc. will not be registered to applicants other than owners of such channels).

name: Commercial and matrimonial catalogue ban
description: A title that presents itself as a classifieds, matrimonial or product-listing service is not admissible as a periodical title.
source_clause: Titles using words like Ad or Advertisement, Classifieds, Tender, Calendar, Panchang, Matrimonial, Yellow pages (generally prefixed with white, pink, etc.), pamphlet, brochure, directory, or any such publication which cannot be treated as a periodical shall not be registered.
detection_hint: keyword: matrimonial, classifieds, listings, bazaar, sale, panchang
retrieval_chunk: Titles using words like Ad or Advertisement, Classifieds, Tender, Calendar, Panchang, Matrimonial, Yellow pages (generally prefixed with white, pink, etc.), pamphlet, brochure, directory, or any such publication which cannot be treated as a periodical shall not be registered.
